html:
<!doctype html><html lang="{{LOCALE}}"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><style>{{BASE_STYLE}}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
body{background:#F7F3EE;font-family:'Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif}
#stage{position:relative;width:1080px;min-height:1920px;overflow:hidden;background:#F7F3EE}

/* ── POLAROID CARD BASE ── */
.card{position:absolute;left:50%;transform-origin:center center;background:#fff;width:760px;height:1000px;margin-left:-380px;padding:36px 36px 120px 36px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18);border-radius:4px}
.card .photo{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;border-radius:2px}

/* ── CARD STACK GHOSTS ── */
.card-ghost{position:absolute;left:50%;background:#fff;width:760px;height:1000px;border-radius:4px;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.card-ghost-1{margin-left:-372px;top:calc(var(--card-top) + 10px);transform:rotate(2deg);z-index:1}
.card-ghost-2{margin-left:-388px;top:calc(var(--card-top) + 18px);transform:rotate(-1.5deg);z-index:0}

/* ── DROP-IN ANIMATION ── */
@keyframes drop-in-neg{from{transform:translateY(-120px) rotate(6deg);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-3deg);opacity:1}}
@keyframes drop-in-zero{from{transform:translateY(-120px) rotate(6deg);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0) rotate(0deg);opacity:1}}
@keyframes drop-in-pos{from{transform:translateY(-120px) rotate(-6deg);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0) rotate(2.5deg);opacity:1}}
@keyframes drop-in-neg2{from{transform:translateY(-120px) rotate(6deg);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-2deg);opacity:1}}
@keyframes drop-in-pos2{from{transform:translateY(-120px) rotate(-6deg);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0) rotate(1.5deg);opacity:1}}
@keyframes drop-in-neg3{from{transform:translateY(-120px) rotate(4deg);opacity:0}to{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-1deg);opacity:1}}

/* ── SCENES ── */
.scene{position:absolute;width:1080px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}

/* ── HOOK SCENE (s1) ── */
.scene.hook{top:0;height:1920px;background:#F7F3EE}
.scene.hook .card{top:460px;animation:drop-in-neg 320ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
.scene.hook .card-ghost-1{--card-top:470px}
.scene.hook .card-ghost-2{--card-top:470px}
.scene.hook .card .cap{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;width:100%;height:120px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.scene.hook .card .cap .title{font-size:80px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;color:#1E1E23;letter-spacing:-1px}
.scene.hook .card .cap .title .hl{background:#FFF2CC;color:#1E1E23;padding:0 6px;display:inline}

/* ── PHOTO CARD SCENES ── */
.scene.photo-scene{background:#F7F3EE}
.scene.photo-scene .card-ghost-1,.scene.photo-scene .card-ghost-2{position:absolute}
.scene.photo-scene .card .cap{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;width:100%;height:120px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.scene.photo-scene .card .cap .label{font-size:56px;font-weight:700;color:#1E1E23;letter-spacing:-0.5px;text-align:center}
.scene.photo-scene .card .cap .label .hl{background:#FFF2CC;color:#1E1E23;padding:0 4px}

/* ── MASKING TAPE ── */
.tape{position:absolute;width:160px;height:32px;background:rgba(255,212,0,.6);border-radius:3px;z-index:20}
.tape-hook{top:448px;left:50%;margin-left:-80px;transform:rotate(12deg)}
.tape-end{bottom:200px;right:120px;transform:rotate(-8deg)}
.tape-s2{top:calc(var(--scene-top) + 36px);left:50%;margin-left:200px;transform:rotate(12deg)}
.tape-s3{top:calc(var(--scene-top) + 36px);left:50%;margin-left:-300px;transform:rotate(-6deg)}

/* ── ENDING SCENE ── */
.scene.end{background:#F7F3EE}
.scene.end .mat{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:32px}
.scene.end .copy{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;width:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:24px;padding-bottom:200px}
.scene.end .end-name{font-size:96px;font-weight:700;color:#1E1E23;letter-spacing:-2px;font-style:italic}
.scene.end .end-cta{font-size:52px;font-weight:700;color:#1E1E23}
.scene.end .end-cta .hl{background:#FFF2CC;color:#1E1E23;padding:0 8px}
.scene.end .end-location{font-size:38px;color:#6B6460;font-weight:400;margin-top:8px}
.scene.end .tape{bottom:calc(100% - 160px);right:80px;transform:rotate(12deg)}

/* ── COPY / HEADLINE GLOBAL ── */
.mat{position:relative}
.copy{position:absolute;left:60px;right:60px}
.headline{color:#1E1E23;font-weight:700}

/* ── NTH-CHILD LAYOUT VARIANTS ── */
.scene:nth-child(2) .card{transform:rotate(-3deg);animation:drop-in-neg 320ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
.scene:nth-child(3) .card{transform:rotate(2.5deg);animation:drop-in-pos 320ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
.scene:nth-child(4) .card{transform:rotate(-2deg);animation:drop-in-neg2 320ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
.scene:nth-child(5) .card{transform:rotate(1.5deg);animation:drop-in-pos2 320ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
.scene:nth-child(6) .card{transform:rotate(-1deg);animation:drop-in-neg3 320ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
.scene:nth-child(7) .card{transform:rotate(3deg);animation:drop-in-pos 320ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
.scene:nth-child(8) .card{transform:rotate(-2.5deg);animation:drop-in-neg 320ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) both}
</style></head><body><main id="stage">{{SCENES}}</main>{{PLAYER}}</body></html>
